title: Cloud Self Service
subtitle: Every screen a Maude Cloud customer walks through, in order — a legend board plus 14 screen boards across 5 stages, each annotated with sticky notes
brief: udelej mi nejdriv kompletni design vsech screens ktere aktualne v cloud maude uzivatel musi projit, chci videt cely self service hub a pridej mi k tomu sticky notes at vidim cely proces hezky vedle sebe. Potrebuji videt komplet user flow

sections.title: 1 · Arrive
sections.subtitle: cloud.maude.sh — the two doors, and the account behind both

sections.title: 2 · Buy
sections.subtitle: empty dashboard → wizard → Stripe → waiting room. The only irreversible step in the flow.

sections.title: 3 · Open it
sections.subtitle: the dashboard, the last door, and the hand-off into the desktop app

sections.title: 4 · Run it
sections.subtitle: self-administration — people, money, and the copy on GitHub

sections.title: 5 · Leave it · more devices
sections.subtitle: the exit that makes the rest credible, and the door for a second machine

artboards.label: 00 · how to read this board
artboards.note: The entry point: title block, the five-stage spine with its board ranges, and the key for the three sticky-note colours (what happens / gap / fork). Exists because DCSection renders display:contents inside DesignCanvas, so section titles never reach the screen — the chapter spine has to live on the boards themselves.

artboards.label: A1 · landing · cloud.maude.sh
artboards.note: pages.mjs homePage — lockup, 'A home for your design projects', Google button first-class beside 'Create an account'. Gap note: the bill of materials (desktop computer, Maude app, paid Anthropic subscription) is never stated.

artboards.label: A2 · create account · sign in
artboards.note: pages.mjs signupPage + loginPage side by side — Google wide, the in-page disclosure card + consent tick, ?next= carry-back, one error message for both fields. Gap note: Google consent screen still in Testing.

artboards.label: B1 · your projects · empty
artboards.note: dashboard.mjs dashboardPage, zero projects — the full appShell arrives before anything is in it. Gap note: production audit_log holds no project-creation event; the wizard has never run.

artboards.label: B2 · start a project · the wizard
artboards.note: checkout-pages.mjs newProjectPage — name, two plan tiles, monthly/annual, trial framing. Gap note: this is the last honest moment before a card form.

artboards.label: B3 · payment details · Stripe (not our page)
artboards.note: Stripe-hosted checkout on checkout.stripe.com — the one surface in the flow that is not ours. Gap note: rk_test_ key, every live price id null, no automatic_tax, no legal pack, no public pricing page.

artboards.label: B4 · waiting room · three endings
artboards.note: checkout-pages.mjs waitingRoomPage — named steps never a percentage (DDR-203), meta-refresh not script, the 'have I been charged?' answer on screen. Ready and failed endings shown. Gap note: max_instances = 1 and Worker-global per-tenant config.

artboards.label: C1 · your projects · every state
artboards.note: dashboard.mjs with four cards across the STATE_COPY ladder + the ⋯ menu open. Download everything appears in every state. Gap note: the reconciler computes suspend-cell and never runs it.

artboards.label: C2 · open your project · the last door
artboards.note: project-admin.mjs connectPage — 'In the Maude app' one-click handoff vs 'In your browser'. Gap note: the browser card instructs a workspace password no customer is ever issued; Windows download is unsigned.

artboards.label: C3 · maude:// hand-off · the app opens
artboards.note: handoff.mjs launchPage + the desktop app arriving attached. One-time code, 120s, burn-before-decide; the app redeems against its OWN configured cloud address. Gap note: the second (Anthropic) bill lands here.

artboards.label: D1 · people · invitation · join
artboards.note: people-page.mjs peoplePage + the invitation email + invites.mjs invitePage (create-account mode). The invitation IS the account. Gap note: the viewer's gallery is linked from nowhere and only a terminal can publish into it.

artboards.label: D2 · billing · handed to Stripe
artboards.note: checkout-pages.mjs billingPage — we state the situation, Stripe's portal owns everything that changes it. All three state cards shown. Gap note: the past-due → suspend → export → purge ladder has never run.

artboards.label: D3 · GitHub copy · activity log
artboards.note: project-admin.mjs mirrorPage + auditPage — additions-only hourly copy to a repo the customer owns, and the audit log in the customer's language (AUDIT_COPY). Together these are the trust surface.

artboards.label: E1 · download everything · delete
artboards.note: project-admin.mjs downloadPage + deletePage — delete is gated on an export existing. Gap notes: 'it opens without Maude' describes a git bundle; delete never purges tenants/<id>/ from storage.

artboards.label: E2 · connect an app · connected devices
artboards.note: device-auth.mjs activatePage + accountPage — the device-code path in from a second machine, and the list of connected apps with the offline-revocation caveat.
